Op. 7030L24 SLIDING BLIND MOVEMENT MOTOR - R.R.

1. Working at the bench, move the blind (1a) backwards manually until the bolts (1b) on both the side guides (1c) can be accessed.

2. Working on both side guides (1c), undo the bolts (1b) and (2a).

3. Remove the crossmember (3a) from the side guides (1c).

After the removal of the crossmember (3a), the side guides (1c) are no longer kept in the correct position by the actual crossmember; therefore, during the movement, they can be easily moved with the blinds (3a) consequently coming out of the guides.

Removing

- Check that the blinds are correctly inserted in the side sliding guides.
